newsitem.title: USA: Dollar Tree prices offering at $48.50/shr.
newsitem.headline: Dollar Tree prices offering at $48.50/shr.

text.p: Dollar Tree Stores Inc said on Friday that its four million share public offering has been priced at $48.50 per share.
The company also said it has increased the offering size by 500,000 shares. When first announced on June 6, Dollar Tree said it planned an offering of 3.5 million shares.

Of the four million shares, 2,587,500 shares are being offered by the SK Equity Fund LP and 1,412,500 shares are being offered by founding shareholders and certain affiliates, it said. Dollar Tree expects the offering to close June 25.
Underwriters include Montgomery Securities, Alex Brown & Sons Inc, Goldman Sachs & Co and Smith Barney Inc.
